summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.with in its own file, following the spec steps 1-11 in order. ValidateTypedArray, TypedArrayLength, ToAbsoluteIndex (written locally and flagged as not yet in ops), ToBigInt/ToNumber by content type, IsValidIntegerIndex with RangeError, TypedArrayCreateSameType, and the get/set loop all match the spec order and abrupt-completion handling. Each step is kept as a comment above its code. There are no test-shaped branches, hardcoded values, or made-up returns. The gate shows 46 new passes, 0 regressions, and lint is clean. The diff is plausible for the size of the test directory. Minor nits only: an Option from element_type is mapped with is_some_and (unreachable None after validation), and step 10c uses `?` where the spec uses `!` (the helper cannot fail there). Neither changes observable behaviour.
notes_for_next_attempt: No blocking issues. Optional follow-ups: (1) to_absolute_index is a local helper in prototype_with.rs; since at/slice/copyWithin and others need it, consider moving it to kahvi_core::ops in a separate architect-owned change. (2) Step 10c uses `?` on typed_array_set_element where the spec says `Perform !`; this is harmless because the value is already converted, but it could be written to match the spec. (3) The element_type(...).is_some_and(|k| k.is_bigint()) check could use an explicit expect or match, so an unexpected None does not silently select the Number path.
